headline: West Woods LED project, a Donner 88 piano donation, and school building use requests.
summary: Discussion covers building repair schedules and heating and cooling concerns. Action items include the West Woods LED project, a piano donation, and building use requests for school facilities.
items: Discussion on district building repair schedule
Discussion of West Woods LED Project
Discussion of donation of a Donner 88 Keyboard Piano to the Fine and Performing Arts Department

Approval of Whitneyville Civic Association use of boardroom at 60 Putnam Ave. on October 15, 2026, February 21 and April 15, 2027, 7-8:30pm, for meetings

ANNOUNCEMENT OF ZOOM OPERATIONS COMMITTEE 
MEETING AGENDA 
When: October 6, 2026 7:00 PM  
Location- Zoom 
 
To join the meeting virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/88676953454?pwd=0OPDHG09TK8vCqyboR90UWDXEKLpcw.1  
Passcode: 262408 
 
Telephone: +1 646 558 8656, +1 646 931 3860, +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968, +1 309 205 3325 
Webinar ID: 886 7695 3454 
Passcode: 262408 
 
Note: Any member of the public may request, in writing, a physical location and “any electronic equipment necessary” to attend the 
meeting in real-time. Said request shall be made to tdonnarummo@hamden.org not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior to the 
meeting. 
For those who wish to make Public Comments: Time will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of 
the meeting. We ask that public comments be limited to no more than 1 minute in length. You may also submit 
your comment in writing. Public comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's 
subject stating the meeting's name and date (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public 
comments will be accepted up to 1pm the day of the meeting. Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the 
message. 
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 
characters). 
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would 
extend beyond the time allotted for public comment. 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
2. Public Comments on Agenda Items 
3. Additions to the Agenda 
4. Information Item 
a. Discussion on district building repair schedule 
b. Discussion on building heating/cooling concerns 
c. Discussion of West Woods LED Project  
d. Discussion of the donation of a Donner 88 Keyboard Piano to the Fine and Performing Arts 
Department 
 
5. Action Items 
a. Approval of West Woods LED Project 
b. Approval of the donation of a Donner 88 Keyboard Piano to the Fine and Performing Arts 
Department 
c. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Parks and Rec to use gymnasium at Hamden High 
School on Mondays from October 19, 2026-May 10, 2027 from 6:30-9:30pm for Volleyball 
d. Approval of the building use by the Whitneyville Civic Association to use the boardroom at 60 
Putnam Ave. on October 15, 2026, February 21 and April 15, 2027 from 7-8:30pm for meetings 
e. Approval of the building use by the Magnolia Theater Company to use the auditorium, a 
classroom and the music/band rooms at Hamden Middle School on December 18, 2026 from 3-
8pm and December 19, 2026 from 12-4pm for rehearsal and performance of the Nutcracker 
 
6. Adjournment
